content.body:
The French Army employed both the Lebel and the MAS rifles as sniper rifles, although the MAS was not employed until much later on relative to the Lebel. Currently in World War II Online, French snipers use the Lebel.
Snipers were often recruited from the finest marksman in the force. They were assigned to hit high-value targets. Snipers were so highly-valued and respected among themselves that they often followed their own code of ethics. Among these ethical rules was that a sniper would not kill an enemy sniper unless it was absolutely necessary.
